records.classification: A01 pitch-CV absolute error/temperature acceptance remains unresolved; do not infer oscillator tracking target applies unchanged.
records.excerpt:
This is a **partial illustrative budget**, not a guaranteed sum in cents. The offset terms use nominal resistor ratios and omit the separate OFFSET input buffer, manual/reference paths and precision jack-output amplifier. Source impedance, real loading, amplifier input currents and simultaneous resistor errors also need a complete analysis. The [retained TI source](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/opa4197.pdf) is SBOS737C, physical PDF index 6 / printed page 7, Section 6.7 VOS and drift rows (`src-op-precision-datasheet`; `fact-op-precision-input-offset-voltage`). Calibration must measure zero at ATTEN centre, ±1 endpoint gain, OFFSET CV unity, manual midpoint/endpoints, output DC and drift, and clip thresholds at ±10 V. An owner-defined cents tolerance is still required before accepting pitch-CV service.

## Model and current evidence

records.classification: Historical ideal-algebra model test, excludes physical output/protection/temperature; not measured A01 accuracy.
records.excerpt:
Seven ideal-opamp ngspice DC cases in `design/spec/modules/spice/offset-*.cir` check gain −1/0/+1, mixed offset/CV and the mathematical ±15 V extreme. Every modeled `OUT_INTERNAL` differs from the algebraic target by under 1 mV. Before execution, `offset_model_contract.py` checks the captured resistor values and nets, amplifier inputs/output pins, wiper polarity and internal branch set. A wrong wire, swapped amplifier input, missing/duplicate/DNP modeled part or added internal branch is rejected before the ideal deck can return a misleading pass. The report records the checked projection and its idealized boundaries. Pot contact resistance, saturation, op-amp macromodel, output isolation, LEDs, temperature and recovery are not modeled. `design/reports/spice/offset.json` records the runs.

The planning worksheet `design/reports/current/offset.json` counts per cell three whole OPA4197 packages, one OPA4196, two ADG5412F, two comparator packages, one REF5050, three magnitude LEDs, one clip LED, manual pot, input feeds and an output load. The six-cell **planning upper** is +12 V 196.95 mA, −12 V 173.55 mA and +5 V 1.8 mA. Guaranteed maxima are null. The amount is material to #33/#34 rail closure and could force topology/package consolidation; it is neither a measured current nor a supplier guarantee.

records.classification: Load change only; cannot allocate entire target to AGND or infer total static gain accuracy.
records.excerpt:
Nominal output loading is 100 kΩ; the design load envelope extends down to 10 kΩ. A 998 Ω general output loses 0.988% into 100 kΩ and 9.075% into 10 kΩ. Precision outputs instead sense the jack after the isolation resistor. Their **load-induced** DC error target is at most 1 mV between open circuit and 10 kΩ at −5, 0 and +5 V. The separate calibrated static path target is 2 mV. Neither target establishes sample-and-hold droop or oscillator tracking.

No jack switch contact creates a normal connection. Unpatched modules remain independent.

records.classification: 4.166667mV equivalent is total across reference/pitch/core, not available solely to harness return.
records.excerpt:
The standard's 2 mV octave-step and five-cent tracking figures remain **targets**. Five cents at 1 V/oct is about 4.167 mV equivalent error, shared among the reference, pitch path and core. Individual 0.1% resistors alone cannot establish it.

## Verification and remaining gates

records.classification: Proposed1mV allocation and200uV return share; no owner adoption or measured pass.
records.excerpt:
Proposed worst-case absolute per-receiver error allocation is contact 100 µV, remote return 200 µV, loading 200 µV, drift 200 µV, peak noise 100 µV, source/buffer offset 200 µV: total **1000 µV**. Two adjacent receiver errors could differ by 2000 µV, leaving no margin against the 2 mV adjacent-step target. Correlation and actual transfer need review; bandwidth, temperature span and ageing interval are OPEN. DC error terms are Iload Rcontact, Ibias Zsource, gain/offset and remote AGND shift; drift is TC × ΔT plus ageing, noise is evaluated over a defined bandwidth with a reviewed peak convention. A local buffer leaves remote-ground error intact. Every actual term is unknown, so this budget is not passed. Five-cents tracking at 25 °C is a separate target and is not inferred from this allocation.

The existing conditional fanout report is retained with its exact local output/load rows, 100 Ω isolation, 100 Ω feedback, 1 nF compensation and 2 mA driver planning limit. Those values are historical powered-operation conditions, not new placement or stability authority. Feedback remains local. The eight controls retain their interface classifications: five unbuffered pots and three mechanical selectors. Nominal Rpot/4 is not a tolerance bound: a 100 kΩ pot with +20% resistance reaches 30 kΩ before source/contact impedance; 1 nF then yields 30 µs as a simple pole estimate only. Source drive, switch transitions, receiver nonlinearities, capacitance and settling still need qualification. No buffer is presumed for a wiper.

conclusions: Electrical E01-E09 accepted for draft capture under owner-delegated PROPOSAL, not hardware-qualified values. User decision ledger does not supply a numeric A01 cents tolerance.

Retain original plane-only0.5mohm return/1mohm rail criteria and separately account contacts/wires/joints; expanded architecture whole-branch wording needs reconciliation, not automatic blanket rejection of GH.

No universal cents threshold applies to all functions. A01 owner-defined pitch-CV tolerance remains missing. OSC5cents is tracking target with stated calibration/range/temperature, not a new A01 absolute error limit.

Output load-induced1mV and calibrated static2mV are different tests; octave-step2mV and oscillator5cents are different obligations. Return shift requires actual common-path current and transfer sensitivity plus remaining error allocations.
Model pass criteria are scoped historical verification, not measured complete-module acceptance. Mechanical/strap/support elaboration remains frozen.
